wwo.name: Sydney
wwo.method: The 1900 Health Map supplies Sydney Cove, its headlands and selected wharves. A continuous western harbour shoreline follows the NSW Department of Lands 1890 survey, through Johnstone Bay, Blackwattle Bay and the Darling Harbour head. The two editions meet in the water and along the east Darling Harbour bank. The historic bridge and its approaches follow the 1890 survey. Ultimo, Surry Hills and Moore Park use the traced survey network and the mapped use boundaries. Road replacement follows only the immediate vicinity of the traced streets. Port works between editions, waterfront registration beyond the controls, and smaller untraced streets remain unresolved. Frontage lots and paving outside traced footprints are inferred.

registration.limits: Seven approximate feature matches. Independent registration of the peripheral areas is absent. Some waterfront features changed inside the date window. Stable street controls are approximate.
